notesForLead: R3-103: the hotel line ends the sentence, so السَّبْت stays in pause form (house style): لِلَيْلَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ يَوْمَ السَّبْت. The tanwin on لَيْلَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ is kept as the decision writes it. English: 'two rooms for one night, on Saturday.' Day 59 is G2.

R3-107: the level test is moved to nine (التَّاسِعَة / التَّاسِعَةِ), an hour before Daniel's work starts at ten and right after the 7-9 morning group; Arabic, segs and English changed in lines 13 and 14.

R3-96: the same old wording ('present form with a sukūn') is also in grammar.json line ~1928 (G5, card summary) and course.json line ~2168 (week-test explain, G3). Those are not G4 files; align them if the owning planners did not.

R3-101: 'very delicious' is now used for لَذِيذ جِدًّا / لَذِيذًا جِدًّا in the café, restaurant and Eid scenarios and in the food culture reading. Outside G4 the same phrase is still 'very tasty': vocabulary.json kak example (G5) and day71.json line ~1138 (G3). Change them for one rendering if wanted.

R3-23/R3-102 (Dinner for two): the only non-dual greeting in this scenario was أَهْلًا بِكَ (line 1) -> أَهْلًا بِكُمَا; تَفَضَّلَا and شُكْرًا لَكُمَا were already dual. The culture note now also lists أَهْلًا بِكُمَا. Daniel's تَفَضَّلْ / شُكْرًا لَكَ to the single waiter stays.

R12-40 (holiday): لَمْ تَذْهَبْ -> لَمْ تَذْهَبَا, seg and English ('You two didn't go…') follow. Huda's later questions to Daniel (لَمْ تَذْهَبِي is Daniel to Huda; خَرَجْتُمْ is to Huda's family) are unaffected.

R12-10: restaurant (Cairo) spot اللَّبَن -> الزَّبَادِي 'the yogurt'. morning-routine keeps اللَّبَن because the photo and caption are a Levantine (Jordanian) breakfast, even though the dialogue's host family is Egyptian; its label is now 'the yogurt (Levant)'. Dietary (Amman, Lebanese mezze) keeps اللَّبَن, label 'the yoghurt (Levant), on the aubergine'. Two scoped taps add 'in Egypt laban is milk'.

R12-8: the café spot is now the two-word phrase طَاوِلَةُ الْخِدْمَة (phrase meaning comes from the spot's en 'the counter'); neither word existed anywhere in the course, so both single-word taps get a scoped gloss at scenario:cafe.

R12-2: placard pc.courtesy item مَبْرُوك gets note 'Everyday; formal: مُبَارَك' plus a scoped tap مُبَارَك at placard:pc.courtesy (the app-wide sense is 'blessed'). Clothes-shop line 11 English 'Enjoy it!' -> 'Congratulations!'.

R3-104: captions keep the photos and now say 'Photo: <real place>' and, where the dialogue is elsewhere, say so: café (Cairo photo, Amman dialogue; 'Cairo coffeehouse' reworded), morning-routine, directions (Amman photo, Cairo dialogue), clothes-shop (Amman photo, Cairo dialogue), holiday-story (Petra photo, Luxor/Aswan trip), lost-phone-help (Petra kiosk, Amman story), museum-info (Egyptian Museum photo, Jordan Museum dialogue), post-office (Jordan Post photo, Cairo dialogue). The post-office caption ops avoid the الْأُرْدُنِيّ word (Z pass). Captions without a place claim (Helsinki hotel, Toronto carousel, Qatar majlis, Dead Sea for Ain Sokhna…) are left as they are.
R12-11: restaurant line 3 الشُّبَّاك -> النَّافِذَة (seg too); both السُّور railing spots (directions, clothes-shop) -> الدَّرَابْزِين, matching weather-plans.
R12-13: kept بِنَفْسِي after the decided wording: سَأَتَأَكَّدُ مِنْ ذٰلِكَ مَعَ الطَّبَّاخِ بِنَفْسِي; English 'I will check that with the cook myself'.
